entries.query: Rook voice for an incoming horde; how far a famous film line may be twisted; bark length

excerpts.text: A real line twisted into the Rigs' world is allowed when clearly modified: the wink is the joke
a cocky, odds-dismissing smuggler crossed with a tired, sarcastic blue-collar worker
Cocky; waves the odds away; improvises first, thinks later, and defends a shaky plan with total confidence.
